en: For just ¥500, you can play the\nSAFARI GAME.\pYou can roam the wide-open safari\nand catch what you like.\pWould you like to play?
That'll be ¥500, please!\pWe only use a special kind of \nPOKé BALLS here.
We'll call you on the PA when you\nrun out of time or SAFARI BALLS.\pWell, I'll wish you the best of\nluck!
Are you going to leave the\nSAFARI ZONE early?
Please return any SAFARI BALLS\nyou may have left.
Did you catch your fair share?\nCome again!
Hi! Is it your first time here at\nthe SAFARI ZONE?

The SAFARI ZONE actually has
four zones in it.\pEach zone has different kinds of
POKéMON, even some rare ones.\pUse the supplied SAFARI BALLS to
catch them.\pYou can also throw BAIT or ROCKS
besides the SAFARI BALLS.\pIf you throw BAIT, the POKéMON
becomes less likely to flee, but\lharder to catch.\pIf you throw ROCKS, the POKéMON
becomes more likely to flee, but\leasier to catch.\pWhen you run out of time or SAFARI
BALLS, it's game over for you!
